output.answer: Five Guys was founded in 1986 by Jerry and Janie Murrell, who opened the first takeout restaurant in Arlington, Virginia after asking their sons whether they wanted to go to college or start a business. The name 'Five Guys' originally referred to Jerry Murrell and the couple's first four sons — Jim, Matt, Chad, and Ben (a fifth son, Tyler, was born two years later, and all five sons are now involved in the business). The company's own history page calls Jerry Murrell the founder of the family-owned chain, which still bears the Murrell family as its owner today.
caveats: The founder is not a single person: the chain was started by the married couple Jerry and Janie Murrell together with their sons, and 'the five guys' of the name are Jerry and the first four sons. Some accounts emphasize Jerry Murrell as 'the founder' because he is the family patriarch, but Janie Murrell is co-listed as a founder in standard references.

Whether the 'five guys' originally counted Jerry plus four sons (the most common account, including the company's own history) is sometimes retold with slight variation in press coverage, but Jerry and Janie Murrell as the 1986 founders is consistent across the company's official history and secondary references.

passages.quote: Five Guys came to be in 1986 when Jerry and Janie Murrell asked their three sons a simple question: Do you want to go to college or start a business? The boys chose to start a business and not long after, the Murrell family opened a quaint takeout spot in Arlington, Virginia.

passages.source_url: A really good hamburger is one of life’s simplest pleasures. Five Guys founder Jerry Murrell took that simplicity to heart. Like his mother always told him, “If you can give a good haircut or if you can serve a good drink at a bar or if you can serve a good hamburger, you can always make money in America.”

passages.quote: Five Guys was founded in 1986 by Janie and Jerry Murrell. Jerry and the couple's sons Jim, Matt, Chad, and Ben were the original "Five Guys". The Murrells had a fifth son, Tyler, two years later.
passages.source_url: Five Guys was founded in 1986 by Janie and Jerry Murrell. Jerry and the couple's sons Jim, Matt, Chad, and Ben were the original "Five Guys".[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Five_Guys#cite_note-biggerbite-1)[\[17\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Five_Guys#cite_note-Restaurant_Business-17) The Murrells had a fifth son, Tyler, two years later.
